FrontPage.title: <title>Uwezo Fund’s</title> <lineBreak></lineBreak> <subTitle><light>aim is to enable</light> women, youth <light>and</light> persons with disabilities <light>to access finances to</light> promote businesses <light>and</light> enterprises <light>at the constituency level.</light></subTitle>
FrontPage.description: Self-help groups that meet <underline>eligibility criteria</underline> can apply for a loan to advance their projects and enterprises.

criteria.title: Eligibility Criteria
criteria.one: Group must be registered with the Department of Social Services, Cooperatives or the Registrar of Societies body with a valid group registration certificate
criteria.two: Group membership must be as guided by the registering entity, membership should be between 10-15 members.
criteria.three:
Group Membership must be at least:
  • For youth groups: membership at least 70% youth (18-35 years), and leadership 100% youth
  • For women’s groups: membership at least 70% women (18+ years), and leadership 100% women
  • For people with disabilities groups: membership at least 70% PWDs, and leadership 100% PWDs
criteria.four: Group operates a table banking structure or any other group fund structure where members make monthly contribution according to the group’s internal guidelines
criteria.five: Group holds a bank account in the name of the group
criteria.six: Institutions are eligible if they have listed youth, women, and PWDs groups within them

fundDescription.title: Uwezo Fund
fundDescription.description: Uwezo Fund is a flagship programme for vision 2030 aimed at enabling women, youth and persons with disabilities access finances to promote businesses and enterprises at the constituency level, thereby enhancing economic growth towards the realization of the same and the Sustainable Development Goals No.1 (eradicate extreme poverty and hunger) and 3 (promote gender equality and empower women). The Fund is highly devolved and adopted the concept of bottom-up approach with decision making done at the grass-root level.
fundDescription.objectives: The Fund is revolving in nature and its operations are based in the constituencies. The Objectives of the Fund are;

objectivesList.one: To expand access to finances for the youth, women and persons with disabilities at the constituency level for businesses and enterprises development;
objectivesList.two: To generate gainful self- employment for the youth and women; and
objectivesList.three: To model an alternative framework in funding community driven development initiatives.

stepDescription.title: What is being done in this step?
stepDescription.memberConfirmation: Your application has been submitted and SMS messages have been sent to all group members who require confirmation. Each member will receive a link to confirm or decline their participation in the loan application. Once at least 75% of members have confirmed, your application will automatically proceed to the next step.
stepDescription.inReview:
• The application will be checked on the local constituency level for any discrepancies.
  • Verification with relevant offices (local chief, credit organisations, social service office, etc).
  • If required, your group members will be contacted for an additional interview.
stepDescription.readMoreInReview: Read more about the reviewing step
stepDescription.pending: Your application has been submitted successfully! Once a sufficient batch of applications has cleared the initial review, the Constituency Uwezo Fund Management Committee will gather to discuss the applications and make a recommendation about the loan application. The committee recommendations will be approved by the Uwezo Board.
stepDescription.readMorePending: Read more about the committee <lineBreak></lineBreak> decision making process
stepDescription.approved: Congratulations! Your loan application has been approved by the Uwezo Fund Management Committee. You will be contacted soon regarding the next steps for loan disbursement.
stepDescription.rejected: Unfortunately, your application has been rejected. Please review the rejection details above for specific reasons. You may submit a new application after addressing the issues mentioned.
stepDescription.disbursed: Your loan has been successfully disbursed to your group's designated bank account. Please ensure timely repayments according to your agreed schedule.
stepDescription.closed: This application has been closed. No further action is required. If you have questions, please contact our support team.

processTimeline.title: How long will it take?
processTimeline.memberConfirmation: Member confirmations typically take 1-3 days. You will be notified via SMS once enough members have confirmed. If members do not respond within a reasonable time, you may need to follow up with them directly.
processTimeline.inReview: Applications usually take a few days to get to the next step where these will be reviewed by the Constituency Uwezo Fund Management Committee.
processTimeline.pending: The whole process usually takes a month.
